posts.title: Preparing for Incidents With Tabletop Exercises
posts.description: People practice fire and tornado drills so they know how to respond to emergencies. You can do the same with software systems your team owns.

posts.title: Generating v7 UUIDs in MySQL
posts.description: MySQL's UUID() function generates v1 UUIDs, which are time-based, but not time-ordered. We can define our own function to generate v7 UUIDs, which are more appropriate for primary keys.
